import json
import sys

try:
    from framework_evidence import run_tool
except Exception as exc:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "could not load framework_evidence.run_tool", "detail": str(exc)}))
    sys.exit(1)

argv = [
    "nmap",
    "-n",
    "-sT",
    "-sU",
    "-sV",
    "--top-ports",
    "100",
    "192.168.5.0/24",
]

try:
    result = run_tool(argv)
    if isinstance(result, str):
        print(result)
    else:
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
except Exception as exc:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "tool execution failed", "argv": argv, "detail": str(exc)}))
    sys.exit(1)

def find_tool_runs(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        runs = value.get("tool_runs")
        if isinstance(runs, list):
            return runs
        for child in value.values():
            found = find_tool_runs(child)
            if found:
                return found
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            found = find_tool_runs(child)
            if found:
                return found
    return []


def main():
    argv = [
        "curl", "--silent", "--show-error", "--location", "--max-redirs", """10""",
        "--connect-timeout", "5", "--max-time", "30", "--dump-header", "/dev/stderr",
        "--write-out",
        "\\n" + MARKER + " status=%{http_code} effective_url=%{url_effective} content_type=%{content_type} size_download=%{size_download} redirects=%{num_redirects}",
        URL,
    ]
    envelope = run_tool(argv)
    runs = find_tool_runs(envelope)
    run = runs[-1] if runs else {}
    stdout = run.get("stdout", "") if isinstance(run, dict) else ""
    stderr = run.get("stderr", "") if isinstance(run, dict) else ""
    stdout = stdout if isinstance(stdout, str) else str(stdout)
    stderr = stderr if isinstance(stderr, str) else str(stderr)

    body, meta = stdout, ""

        meta = MARKER + meta

    lower_body = body.lower()
    login_signals = []

import json
import re

from framework_evidence import run_tool

BASE = "http://192.168.5.8"
MARKER = "__BLUDIT_HTTP_META__"


def request(path):
    url = BASE + path
    argv = [
        "curl", "--silent", "--show-error", "--location", "--max-redirs", "10",
        "--connect-timeout", "5", "--max-time", "30", "--dump-header", "/dev/stderr",
        "--write-out", "\\n" + MARKER + " status=%{http_code} effective_url=%{url_effective} content_type=%{content_type} size_download=%{size_download} redirects=%{num_redirects}",
        url,
    ]
    try:
        envelope = run_tool(argv)
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"requested_url": url, "request_argv": argv,
                "tool_error": type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc),
                "assessment": "inconclusive; request did not produce a tool result"}

    runs = envelope.get("tool_runs", []) if isinstance(envelope, dict) else []
    run = runs[0] if runs and isinstance(runs[0], dict) else {}
    stdout = run.get("stdout", "")
    stderr = run.get("stderr", "")
    if not isinstance(stdout, str):
        stdout = json.dumps(stdout, ensure_ascii=False)
    if not isinstance(stderr, str):
        stderr = json.dumps(stderr, ensure_ascii=False)

    body = stdout
    meta = ""
    if MARKER in stdout:
        body, meta = stdout.rsplit(MARKER, 1)
        body = re.sub(r"\\n$", "", body)
        meta = MARKER + meta.strip()

    challenge = bool(re.search(r"(?im)^WWW-Authenticate\s*:", stderr))
    password_field = bool(re.search(

class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):

class FormParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.forms = []
        self.current = None

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag.lower() == "form":
            self.current = {"action": attrs.get("action", ""),
                            "method": attrs.get("method", "get").lower(),
                            "fields": {}, "buttons": []}
            self.forms.append(self.current)
        elif self.current is not None and tag.lower() == "input":
            name = attrs.get("name")
            if name:
                self.current["fields"][name] = attrs.get("value", "")
        elif self.current is not None and tag.lower() == "button":
            name = attrs.get("name")
            if name:
                self.current["buttons"].append((name, attrs.get("value", "")))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag.lower() == "form":
            self.current = None


def request(opener, url, data=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, data=data,
        headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; authorized-service-check/1.0)",
                 "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,*/*;q=0.8"},
        method="POST" if data is not None else "GET")
    try:
        response = opener.open(req, timeout=TIMEOUT)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        response = exc
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"request_url": url, "method": req.method,
                "transport_error": type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)}
    try:
        raw = response.read()
        headers = response.headers
        charset = headers.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
        try:
            body = raw.decode(charset, errors="replace")
        except LookupError:
            body = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        location = headers.get("Location")
        cookie_names = []
        for value in headers.get_all("Set-Cookie", []):
            name = value.split("=", 1)[0].strip()
            if name:
                cookie_names.append(name)
        safe_headers = {}
        for name in ("Date", "Server", "X-Powered-By", "Content-Type",
                     "Content-Length", "Location", "Cache-Control", "Pragma"):
            value = headers.get(name)
            if value is not None:
                safe_headers[name] = value
        return {"request_url": url, "method": req.method,
                "status": getattr(response, "status", response.getcode()),
                "headers": safe_headers,
                "set_cookie_names": cookie_names,
                "body": body, "body_bytes": len(raw),
                "body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                "location": location}
    finally:
        response.close()


def visible_text(html):
    class TextOnly(HTMLParser):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
            self.parts = []
        def handle_data(self, data):
            text = " ".join(data.split())
            if text:
                self.parts.append(text)
    parser = TextOnly()
    parser.feed(html)
    return " ".join(parser.parts)


def main():
    opener = urllib.request.build_opener(
        urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(), NoRedirect())
    get_result = request(opener, LOGIN_URL)
    if "transport_error" in get_result:
        print(json.dumps({"evidence_version": 1, "target": LOGIN_URL,
                          "form_request": get_result,
                          "authentication_attempt": "not_made",
                          "assessment": "inconclusive: login form could not be retrieved"},
                         sort_keys=True))
        return

    page = get_result.pop("body")
    parser = FormParser()
    parser.feed(page)
    login_form = next((f for f in parser.forms
                       if f["method"] == "post"
                       and any("user" in n.lower() for n in f["fields"])
                       and any("pass" in n.lower() for n in f["fields"])), None)
    if login_form is None:
        print(json.dumps({"evidence_version": 1, "target": LOGIN_URL,
                          "form_request": get_result,
                          "authentication_attempt": "not_made",
                          "assessment": "inconclusive: no recognizable POST login form in current response"},
                         sort_keys=True))
        return

    post_url = urllib.parse.urljoin(LOGIN_URL, login_form["action"] or LOGIN_URL)
    base_parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(BASE)
    post_parts = urllib.parse.urlsplit(post_url)
    if (post_parts.scheme, post_parts.netloc) != (base_parts.scheme, base_parts.netloc):
        print(json.dumps({"evidence_version": 1, "target": LOGIN_URL,
                          "form_request": get_result,
                          "authentication_attempt": "not_made",
                          "assessment": "inconclusive: form action was not same-origin"},
                         sort_keys=True))
        return

    fields = dict(login_form["fields"])
    user_key = next(n for n in fields if "user" in n.lower())
    pass_key = next(n for n in fields if "pass" in n.lower())
    fields[user_key] = USERNAME
    fields[pass_key] = PASSWORD
    for name, value in login_form["buttons"]:
        if name.lower() == "save":
            fields[name] = value
    encoded = urllib.parse.urlencode(fields).encode("utf-8")
    post_result = request(opener, post_url, encoded)

    if "transport_error" in post_result:
        assessment = "inconclusive: credential POST transport failed"
        indicators = []
    else:
        response_body = post_result.pop("body")
        text = visible_text(response_body).lower()
        location = post_result.get("location") or ""
        location_path = urllib.parse.urlsplit(urllib.parse.urljoin(post_url, location)).path.lower() if location else ""
        errors = ("invalid password", "incorrect password", "invalid username",
                  "incorrect username", "wrong password", "login failed",
                  "authentication failed")
        authenticated_markers = ("logout", "log out", "dashboard", "new content")
        indicators = []
        if post_result["status"] in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            if any(word in location_path for word in ("dashboard", "content", "pages")):
                assessment = "accepted: response redirected to an administrative destination"
                indicators.append("redirect_to_administrative_destination")
            elif location_path.rstrip("/") == "/admin" or location_path.rstrip("/") == "/admin/login":
                assessment = "rejected: response redirected back to the login interface"
                indicators.append("redirect_back_to_login")
            else:
                assessment = "inconclusive: redirect observed; destination does not establish authentication"
        elif any(marker in text for marker in errors):
            assessment = "rejected: response contains an explicit credential/login error"
            indicators.append("explicit_login_error_text")
        elif any(marker in text for marker in authenticated_markers) and "type=\"password\"" not in response_body.lower():
            assessment = "accepted: response contains authenticated-interface indicators"
            indicators.append("authenticated_interface_text_without_password_form")
        elif "type=\"password\"" in response_body.lower() or "type='password'" in response_body.lower():
            assessment = "rejected: response presents a password form again, without an explicit success indicator"
            indicators.append("password_form_remains")
        else:
            assessment = "inconclusive: response does not establish acceptance or rejection"

        post_result["body_text_preview"] = visible_text(response_body)[:1200]
        post_result["body_bytes"] = len(response_body.encode("utf-8"))
        post_result["body_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(response_body.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    output = {
        "evidence_version": 1,
        "target": BASE,
        "form_request": get_result,
        "submission": {"method": "POST", "url": post_url,
                       "username": USERNAME, "password": "[REDACTED]",
                       "submitted_field_names": sorted(fields.keys()),
                       "redirects_followed": False, "attempt_count": 1},
        "authentication_response": post_result,
        "indicators": indicators,
        "assessment": assessment
    }
    print(json.dumps(output, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import json
import sys

import framework_evidence


def main():
    commands = [
        "search bludit",
        "search type:exploit bludit",
        "search cve:2019-16113",
        "info exploit/linux/http/bludit_upload_images_exec",
        "exit -y",
    ]
    console_command = "; ".join(commands)
    argv = ["msfconsole", "-q", "-x", console_command]

    try:
        result = framework_evidence.run_tool(argv)
        if isinstance(result, str):
            print(result)
        else:
            print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    except Exception as exc:
        print(json.dumps({
            "evidence_version": 1,
            "command": argv,
            "status": "wrapper_error",
            "error_type": type(exc).__name__,
            "error": str(exc),
        }, ensure_ascii=False))
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
